The rewrite is complete. Here is what changed in `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/CandidateDetailSheet.tsx`:

**Removed:**
- Dark hero header (`bg-foreground text-background`) with the 4xl score number and progress bar
- `CandidateSummary` import and its usage in the scrollable area
- Bottom gradient fade `<div>`
- `Separator` import

**Added:**
- `ScoreRingMini` — 56px SVG circular ring defined locally, colored green/amber/red by score
- `MustHaveSkillsGrid` — pill grid defined locally, green ticks for matched, red X for missing must-haves
- Light `bg-card` header with avatar circle (`bg-primary/10`, initials in primary color), name, location/email, the score ring, strength badge, confidence badge
- Four icon-only action buttons (Phone, WhatsApp, Email, Schedule) wrapped in `TooltipProvider` tooltips
- `StageTracker` moved into the action row with `ml-auto` (right-aligned), only when `onStageChange` is present
- `DropdownMenu` overflow button (MoreHorizontal) containing: Download resume, LinkedIn, Save to Pool, Reject, Archive
- `Tabs` (Overview / Analysis / Team / History) with underline tab style — each tab has its own `ScrollArea` so each scrolls independently
- `useEffect` resets `activeTab` to `"overview"` every time `isOpen` becomes true

**Tab content mapping:**
- Overview: MustHaveSkillsGrid, StrengthsGapsPanel, InterviewQuestionsPanel, CandidateTagInput
- Analysis: CandidateSummaryCard, JDAlignedPanel, SkillsDetailPanel, ExperiencePanel + EducationPanel grid, AuthenticityReport
- Team: AssigneeSelector, CandidateNotesPanel, ScorecardSummary, ScorecardPanel
- History: InterviewsPanel

All dialogs (EmailOutreachDialog, ScheduleInterviewDialog, RejectCandidateDialog, WhatsAppOutreachDialog) and the full `CandidateDetailSheetProps` interface are preserved unchanged.
